title: ALMA millimetre-wavelength imaging of HD 138965: new constraints on the debris dust composition and presence of planetary companions
question: What are the radial extent, width and inclination of the HD 138965 outer debris belt in ALMA 1.3 mm imaging, what dust composition fits, and what limits follow on the dust albedo and on planetary companions

recipe.method: Bayesian inference on a PARSEC v1.2S model grid using Gaia absolute G magnitude, BP-RP colour and [Fe/H], with a pre-main-sequence prior

recipe.goal: Fit the ALMA continuum visibilities with a Gaussian belt
recipe.method: Single Gaussian belt model, RADMC-3D images converted to model visibilities with Galario, sampled with emcee
key_parameters: 90 walkers, 1,000 steps (90,000 realisations); posterior from last 10,000 realisations
Priors for radius, inclination, position angle normal with sd 3% of initial value, from Herschel
assumptions: Star at the phase centre; offsets of the disc centre fitted

recipe.method: Mask the cube to the disc annulus, shift spectra by projected Keplerian velocity, interpolate to common velocities and sum
key_parameters: Spectrum centred on stellar radial velocity of -9.38 km/s from Gaia DR3
assumptions: Keplerian rotation with the continuum-derived disc extent and orientation

recipe.goal: Constrain the inner belt from the SED
recipe.method: Stardust SED fit with inner and outer belts free, then re-run with fixed inner-belt s_min, q and fractional width, leaving only radius and mass free
key_parameters: Fixed for inner belt: s_min = 12 um, q = 3.5, Delta r/r = 0.3
Maximum grain size 3000 um; inner belt astronomical silicate
assumptions: Outer belt grains pure astronomical silicate when fixing the inner belt

recipe.method: Stardust + emcee for each composition (astronomical silicate mixed with crystalline/amorphous water-ice, amorphous carbon or vacuum at volume fractions 0.5, 0.25, 0.1), outer belt radius and width fixed to ALMA values, ranked by BIC
key_parameters: s_min set to the blowout limit of each composition; q allowed 2 to 5
BIC with k = 3 or 4 and N = 15
assumptions: Inner belt fixed from the pure-silicate run; may bias toward astronomical silicate

recipe.goal: Constrain scattered-light brightness, albedo and companion masses from imaging
recipe.method: Inject model discs into SHARDDS data and reduce with classical ADI; RSM contrast curve converted to mass with AMES-COND; HST/ACS surface-brightness limit converted to albedo limit

recipe.goal: Infer planetary companion mass limits from belt architecture
recipe.method: Single-planet sculpting and self-stirring calculations following Pearce et al. using the belt inner edge and stellar parameters
key_parameters: Disc inner edge at 101 au (R - sigma_R)
assumptions: Single planet sculpting, or self-stirring by planetesimals up to 100 km

score_reason: Project code, observing setup, beam, robust and MCMC settings are given and the ALMA continuum fit is repeatable with public data, but calibration/imaging details are generic and the custom Stardust SED code is not released.
rediscovery_reason: ALMA data are public and the Gaussian-belt visibility fit has numeric targets (R, sigma, i, PA, flux), although the SED composition analysis cannot be redone without Stardust.
